_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N358639 (2026-03-11, held-out Part 102 window final; subject: "The country of origin of a pipe assembly."). Frozen by the D570 rule before any run. CBP held South Korea. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 held-out suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8708.99). Family and name: the family check (vehicle_parts, 0.85); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (0: none). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target Mexico by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for Mexico are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D570.
